items.title: GPT-5.6 Sol Ultra will be in Codex
items.author: mfiguiere
items.summary: GPT-5.6 Sol is a new model from Amazon AI, featuring advanced reasoning modes and improved performance in various fields. It is currently in limited preview for select partners. General availability is expected soon.

items.title: Al Vigier: Canada's AI strategy shouldn't include secret Palantir bills
items.author: ClearwayLaw
items.summary: Canada's AI strategy emphasizes sovereign AI, but critics argue it should avoid secretive Palantir contracts. Palantir's large presence raises concerns about capability and sovereignty. Al Vigier argues for transparent, Canadian-focused AI procurement.

items.title: Does Code Cleanliness Affect Coding Agents?
items.author: softwaredoug
items.summary: Code cleanliness does not affect coding agents' task success rates but significantly reduces their operational footprint by 7-8% fewer tokens and 34% fewer file revisitations. This efficiency is observed across multiple studies and evaluations.

items.title: New AI tutor achieves 0.71-1.30 SD effect size in Dartmouth course [pdf]
items.author: jonahbard
items.summary: A new AI tutor achieved a 0.71-1.30 SD effect size in a Dartmouth course. The study is available in a PDF linked in the Hacker News discussion. The effect size indicates significant improvement in student performance.

items.title: Composite Video on the NES: Why's it so wobbly?
items.author: zdw
items.summary: NES composite video is wobbly due to inherent signal degradation and lack of modern video processing, causing artifacts like horizontal lines. This is normal for the NES era. For better quality, use an HDMI adapter.

items.title: Starring the Computer
items.author: gitowiec
items.summary: "Starring the Computer" catalogs computers in film and TV, founded in 2008 by James Carter. It highlights models like IBM AN/FSQ-7 and Commodore 64. The site rates computer scenes by importance, realism, and visibility.

items.title: Mr. Baby Paint and accidentally discovering a new cellular automata
items.author: jfil
items.summary: Mr. Baby Paint accidentally discovered a new cellular automata, which was discussed on Hacker News and Reddit. The discovery was notable for its unexpected nature and mathematical implications.

items.title: Delta flight hit by firework while landing at Midway Airport on Fourth of July
items.author: randycupertino
items.summary: A Delta flight landing at Chicago's Midway Airport on July 4th was reportedly struck by a firework, causing minor damage. The crew reported a loud bang during landing. No injuries were reported.

items.title: Zuckerberg says AI agent development going slower than expected
items.author: cwwc
items.summary: Mark Zuckerberg stated that AI agent development at Meta is slower than anticipated. The company's restructuring has also faced challenges. These issues were discussed in internal meetings.

items.title: A Forlorn Hope of Fortran Modernisation
items.author: Elzair
items.summary: Fortran modernization efforts aim to update the language for modern programming needs, addressing its archaic nature and attracting younger programmers. The proposal includes dependent type theory and parallel programming enhancements. The initiative seeks to maintain Fortran's dominance in scientific computing.

items.title: Dungeon Proof Crawler: learn how to write proofs with RPG
items.author: SchwKatze
items.summary: Dungeon Proof Crawler is an RPG that teaches users how to write mathematical proofs. It received positive feedback for its onboarding and mobile playability. The game was published on Hacker News and Reddit.

items.title: DNSGlobe – Rust TUI to watch DNS propagate around the world
items.author: Callicles
items.summary: DNSGlobe is a Rust TUI for monitoring DNS propagation across 34 global resolvers on a terminal map. It checks DNS records and shows their worldwide spread. It re-polls until full propagation is achieved.

items.title: Dependencies should be fetched directly from VCS
items.author: mrngm
items.summary: Dependencies should be fetched directly from VCS for consistency and reliability. Go handles this by identifying and fetching from the specified VCS URL. This approach avoids reliance on third-party proxies.

items.title: Introduction to Compilers and Language Design (2021)
items.author: AlexeyBrin
items.summary: "Introduction to Compilers and Language Design" teaches compiler construction, focusing on building a simple compiler for a C-like language, and is useful for understanding both theoretical and practical aspects of computer science.

items.title: Show HN: Osint tool that finds exposed files on domains
items.author: PatchRequest
items.text:

the idea is basically another osint tool for pentesters and bug bounty hunters. it watches certificate transparency logs and checks newly-seen domains for exposed stuff like .env files, open .git dirs, config files, db dumps and so on, and puts whatever it finds into a searchable db. you just search a domain (or part of one) and see what's exposed.

it's read-only and free. one thing i've been thinking about a
items.summary: An OSINT tool monitors certificate transparency logs to identify exposed files like.env files and configs on domains. It helps security teams find leaked data before incidents occur. This tool simplifies threat intelligence gathering.

items.title: Run Windows 2000 on a DEC Alpha with a new es40 fork
items.author: jandeboevrie
items.summary: A new es40 fork allows running Windows 2000 on a DEC Alpha, featuring JIT compiler speedups and S3 graphics support. This emulator also supports OpenVMS and Tru64 UNIX with X11. The project is a significant advancement in Alpha emulation.

items.title: The AI Compass Quiz
items.author: ai_critic
items.summary: The AI Compass is an online quiz that assesses your views on AI by categorizing you into thirty archetypes based on your answers. It provides insights into your stance on AI ethics and technology. The quiz is useful for understanding personal perspectives on AI.

items.title: Airplane Boneyards List and Map
items.author: hyperific
items.summary: Major aircraft boneyards include AMARG in Tucson, Arizona, and Pinal Airpark in Arizona. These sites store retired military and commercial aircraft. The boneyards are not affiliated with the Department of Defense or aviation museums.

items.title: Vaclav Havel, the Power of the Powerless (1978)
items.author: iamnothere
items.summary: The Power of the Powerless is a political essay by Václav Havel from 1978 analyzing domination through routine compliance. It was published in 1985 in a volume edited by John Keane. Havel argues that systems of power endure through ordinary people's acquiescence.

items.title: Inventor, Mother, Creator: Grace Hopper
items.author: stmw
items.summary: Grace Hopper was a pioneering computer scientist and U.S. Navy officer who developed the first compiler and played a key role in creating COBOL. She earned a Ph.D. in mathematics and was a professor before her computing innovations.

items.title: OpenWiki: CLI that writes and maintains agent documentation for your codebase
items.author: handfuloflight
items.summary: OpenWiki is a command-line tool that automatically generates and updates documentation for codebases. It uses GitHub actions to keep documentation current. It has over 4,700 stars on GitHub.

items.title: Why DMARC's new "NP" tag can fail with DNSSEC
items.author: matteocontrini
items.summary: The DMARC "NP" tag can fail with DNSSEC because the definition of "non-existent domain" in RFC 9989 conflicts with RFC 9824's "Compact Denial of Existence in DNSSEC". This clash causes the NP tag to not function as intended.

items.title: Fast Software, the Best Software (2019)
items.author: ustad
items.summary: Fast software enhances user experience and engineering quality, with web browsers now being the most efficient cross-platform solution. In 2019, web applications became the preferred choice over traditional cross-platform layers.
